about:
# wow-addons

World of Warcraft addon monorepo centered on **WoW: Forever** (1.60.1, Interface `16001`) alongside multi-client Classic/Retail support — featuring AH gold-making tools, BiS gear lookup, client API probing, and an AI developer Copilot package (`mcp/` + `reference/`).

## Layout

This is a monorepo: one folder per addon under `addons/`, each self-contained and independently installable.

```
wow-addons/
  addons/
    <AddonName>/
      <AddonName>.toc        # and/or <AddonName>_<Client>.toc for multi-client addons
      *.lua
      Knowledge/              # curated, sourced data only — see AGENTS.md
      tests/                  # optional, per-addon Busted specs
  .claude/skills/             # repo-local AI agent skills (wow-addon-partner)
  docs/                       # build measurements, release & Copilot DevKit guides, CurseForge pages
  mcp/                        # wow-api MCP server (verified build signatures, enums & events)
  reference/                  # dumped API JSON/Markdown reference from ForeverProbe
  scripts/
    link-addons.ps1           # symlinks addons/* into your local WoW install(s)
    run-tests.ps1             # Luacheck + Busted test runner (also run-tests.sh)
    check-toc.js              # validates .toc Interface headers, LoadOnDemand & file paths
    check-lua.js              # Lua 5.1 syntax verification across addons/
    package-addon.ps1         # builds clean release zip using .pkgmeta
    package-devkit.ps1        # builds standalone WoW: Forever Addon Copilot DevKit zip
  .github/workflows/
    validate.yml              # syntax, .toc & test checks on push/PR
    release.yml               # tagged addon zip & CurseForge release automation
  AGENTS.md                   # working rules for AI agents and contributors
```

## Local dev setup

1. Clone the repo (`git clone https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons.git`).
2. Run `scripts/link-addons.ps1 -WowPath "<path to your Interface\AddOns folder>"` to symlink every addon in `addons/` into your live WoW install. Symlinks let you edit in the repo and reload in-game with no copy step.
3. Verify edits before committing:
   - `node scripts/check-toc.js addons` and `node scripts/check-lua.js addons`
   - `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-tests.ps1` (runs `luacheck` + `busted`)
4. **WoW: Forever Addon Copilot (`wow-api` MCP):** Build and attach the local MCP server in `mcp/` so AI coding assistants verify `C_*` APIs, events, and enums against live build `70862` captures instead of guessing. See [docs/copilot-devkit.md](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/docs/copilot-devkit.md) for standalone setup, or run `scripts/package-devkit.ps1` to bundle a portable zip for fellow addon developers.

## Addons

| Addon | Client(s) | Status | Link |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **GoldFinder** | Multi-Client (Forever `16001`, Retail, Classic Era, MoP) | `v2.0.0+` — AH deal & snipe scanner, crafting arbitrage, Disenchant EV, Bark/Cross-Market, Goblin Ledger P&L, 30-day charts, Multi-Alt Hub, TradeSkill overlay & taint-safety hardening (CurseForge ID `1715781`) | [README](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/GoldFinder/README.md) |
| **BiSGearFinder** | Forever (`16001`) | `v0.1.0` — Class/spec Best-in-Slot browser (`/bgf`, `/bis`) with dungeon/raid/craft filters and optional `GoldFinder` `[ BiS BoEs ]` bridge | [README](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/BiSGearFinder/README.md) |
| **KenHenRoster** | Multi-Client (Forever `16001`, Retail, Classic Era, TBC) | `v1.0.0` — Alt roster exporter (`/khr`, `KHR1:` / `KHR1J:` / JSON + Forever surnames) & Chroma-Key Portrait Studio (`/khr studio`) for [KenHen.Win](https://kenhen.win/) | [README](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/KenHenRoster/README.md) |
| **MeridianScout** | Forever (`16001`) | `v0.1.0` — Read-only character state, active/completed quests, bind, and observed flight node exporter (`/meridianscout`) | [README](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/MeridianScout/README.md) |
| **ForeverProbe** | Forever (`16001`) | `v0.7.0` — Read-only Blizzard API, event & housing capture (`/fprobe`, `/fpevents`, `/fphouse`) powering `reference/` & `mcp/` | [README](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/ForeverProbe/README.md) |
| **AddonSmokeTest** | Classic Era (`20506`), Forever (`16001`) | `v0.0.1` — Minimal proof-of-life (`/smoketest`) | [TOC](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/AddonSmokeTest/AddonSmokeTest.toc) |
| **AdventurerPlates** | Forever (`16001`) | Discontinued (`v0.3.2`) — Reference implementation for Chomp pull-only comms and 3D model rendering; two-player sharing verified on build 70009 | [README](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/AdventurerPlates/README.md) |
| **AdventurerPlatesPortrait** | Forever (`16001`) | Shelved (`v0.1.0`) — Original minimal portrait prototype superseded by `AdventurerPlates` | [TOC](https://github.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/blob/master/addons/AdventurerPlatesPortrait/AdventurerPlatesPortrait.toc) |

### GoldFinder Live Preview

![GoldFinder AH Tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justadakaje/wow-addons/master/addons/GoldFinder/assets/GoldFinder-AH-Tab.png)

## Related repos

- [GoldCopilot](https://github.com/stryker-max/GoldCopilot) (fork target, upstream: `stryker-max/GoldCopilot`) — MoP Classic port planned. Kept as its own fork rather than folded into this monorepo, to preserve upstream history and MIT attribution and to allow pulling upstream fixes.

releases.notes:
# GoldFinder v2.0.3

Hotfix release for the Professions / TradeSkill window craft margin overlay.

## Fixed
- **TradeSkill Craft Margin Overlay Collision (`BuyHelper.lua`):**
  - The `GoldFinder Margin:` line no longer overlaps Blizzard's `Create All` button or the bottom of the recipe list (e.g. on Tailoring).
  - The margin readout is now a dark/gold footer strip docked directly below the Professions / TradeSkill window, spanning its width, with single-line text and scale sync.

## Verification
- Live-tested on WoW: Forever (`1.60.1.71091`).
- Luacheck strict: `0 warnings / 0 errors in 51 files`.
- Busted unit tests: `94 / 94` passing.

# GoldFinder v2.0.2

Hotfix release resolving the blank **GoldFinder** Auction House tab regression from `v2.0.1`.

## Fixed
- **Blank GoldFinder Auction House Tab & Companion Overlay Strata (`Core.lua`, `Tab.lua`, `Mail.lua`, `BuyHelper.lua`):**
  - Fixed an issue where `UIParent`-parented companion overlays (`GoldFinderAuctionTabPanel`, `GoldFinderMailCollectBtn`, and `GoldFinderTradeSkillBadgeFrame`) copied their host Blizzard `UIPanel`'s `"MEDIUM"` strata instead of promoting strictly above it, allowing `toplevel` `AuctionHouseFrame` backgrounds to paint over the active GoldFinder tab.
  - Added `ns.GetOverlayStrata(hostFrame)` (`MEDIUM -> HIGH`, `HIGH -> DIALOG`, etc.), synced scale and `baseLevel + 10` cleanly inside `Tab.lua`'s `OnShow`, synced `Mail.lua` collect button strata before `Show()`, and added strata assertions in `tests/taint_safety_spec.lua`.

## Verification
- Live-tested on WoW: Forever (`1.60.1.71091`).
- Luacheck strict: `0 warnings / 0 errors in 51 files`.
- Busted unit tests: `94 / 94` passing.

releases.notes:
# GoldFinder v2.0.1

Hotfix & stability release following `v2.0.0`, resolving live-test UI bugs and hardening protected-frame taint safety across WoW: Forever (`16001`), Retail, and Classic clients.

## Fixed
- **UI Taint & Protected Action Hardening:**
  - Parented floating TradeSkill profit badge (`GoldFinderTradeSkillBadgeFrame`), Mailbox `[ Collect Deals ]` button (`GoldFinderMailCollectBtn`), and AH tab panel (`GoldFinderAuctionTabPanel`) to `UIParent` instead of protected Blizzard frames (`ProfessionsFrame`, `TradeSkillFrame`, `InboxFrame`, `AuctionHouseFrame`).
  - Updated `OpenInBuy` in `Tab.lua` to avoid insecure `AuctionHouseFrame.Tabs[1]:Click()` and follow `SelectBrowseResult` cleanly; fixed multi-return truncation in `ns.GetCartTotals()`.
  - Replaced `HideUIPanel(SettingsPanel)` / `settingsPanel:Hide()` in `Config.lua` and switched `Broker.lua` tab switching to `LibStub("LibAHTab-1-0", true)`.
  - Guarded `FCF_OpenNewWindow` with `InCombatLockdown()`, added `issecretvalue` + `tip:IsForbidden()` guards in `Tooltip.lua`, and added `tests/taint_safety_spec.lua`.
- **Smart Buy Parity Advisor (`BuyHelper.lua`):**
  - Dispatched `C_AuctionHouse.SendSearchQuery` / `RefreshCommoditySearchResults` immediately after `SelectBrowseResult` so right-hand AH listings populate instead of spinning on `"Searching..."`.
  - Fixed multi-output conversion math (e.g. `Heart of Fire -> 3x Elemental Fire`) to surface `[Craft Profit]` savings accurately.
- **30-Day Price Chart Modal & Slash Command UX (`Core.lua`, `Tab.lua`, `Sparkline.lua`, `Info.lua`):**
  - Added `ns.ResolveItemID` for `/gf chart <name|link|id>` and `/gf alts [name|link|id]`.
  - Forwarded `Ctrl+Click` from watchlist stars and deal rows (`OnMouseDown`/`OnMouseUp`), raised `GoldFinderPriceChartModal` to `FULLSCREEN_DIALOG` strata with `Raise()`, and fell back to all recorded sightings when `< 2` fall within 30 days.
  - Mirrored slash command output to `SELECTED_CHAT_FRAME` when dedicated chat-tab routing is active and added `/gf bark test`.
- **Embedded Options Layout (`Config.lua`):**
  - Adjusted embedded Settings `scrollChild` size and bottom button spacing in Game Options > AddOns > GoldFinder.

## Packaging & QA
- Excluded `tests` and `.busted` from CurseForge packager archives via `addons/GoldFinder/.pkgmeta`.
- Luacheck strict: `0 warnings / 0 errors in 51 files`.
- Busted unit tests: `94 / 94` passing.

releases.name: GoldFinder v2.0.0
releases.notes:
# GoldFinder v2.0.0

## What's New

### Theme 1 — Smart Buy Parity 2.0 & Disenchant EV (#60)
- Expanded `ns.CONVERSIONS` with Leatherworking hide curing and leather upgrades, Alchemy elemental transmutes (including 3x Elemental Fire), and Enchanting 3:1 Lesser-to-Greater Essence upgrades.
- Upgraded `BuyHelper` with multi-recipe lookup support per reagent and output, plus multi-quantity output unit cost calculation.
- Added Disenchant Expected Value (`ns.GetDisenchantValue`) onto tooltips for uncommon armor and weapons (net after 5% AH cut).
- Added non-tainting TradeSkill / Professions profit margin overlay (`ns.EvaluateRecipeProfit`, `ns.InitTradeSkillOverlay`).

### Theme 3 — Trade Chat Bark Scanner & Cross-Market Arbitrage (#61)
- Passive `CHAT_MSG_CHANNEL` listener on Trade, General, LFG, and World channels (`ns.ParseTradeBark`) with 300s per-seller throttle and `/gf bark [on|off|list]`.
- Neutral vs. Faction AH arbitrage scanner (`ns.FindCrossMarketDeals` and `/gf cross`), modeling 15% Neutral AH vs. 5% Faction AH cuts in both directions.

### Theme 4 — Interactive 30-Day Price Chart Modal & LibSharedMedia-3.0 (#62)
- `Ctrl-Click` any deal row or run `/gf chart <itemID|link>` to open a draggable, Escape-closable 30-day trend chart with 30-day Low, High, Median, 7-day EMA reference line, and per-bar hover tooltips (`ns.ShowPriceChartModal`).
- Added optional `LibSharedMedia-3.0` custom sound discovery and playback (`/gf sound list`, `/gf sound <name>`).

### Theme 2 — Multi-Alt Reagent Hub & Mailbox Expiration Watcher (#63)
- Realm-wide character inventory indexing across bags, bank, and mail (`GoldFinderDB.realms[realm].characters[char]`).
- Per-alt item breakdown surfaced in item tooltips, shopping tooltips, and `/gf alts [itemID|link]`.
- Startup and `/gf alts` warnings when any alt has mail attachments expiring within 3 days (`ns.CheckAltMailExpirations`).

## QA & Packaging
- Luacheck strict: 0 warnings / 0 errors across all 46 files.
- Busted unit tests: 76 / 76 passing.
